title: Chrome embedding: the answer document's messages to its parent (stage A)
description: The postMessage set between an answer document (served by the daemon's answer surface on the answer origin chat-<label>-a.<hub>, web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/answer-surface/index.js) and the window that frames it. Today that parent is the chrome (public/app/asks.js reads size, done and open-chat; the document reads mode: lib/server/answer-surface/public/answer.js:23-29, 106-130); under 08 C-08.7 the hub shell is a parent too, when its Needs you card frames the ask document, so the whole set is written down here. 08 adds pending and undone for the undo window (C-08.8). The document posts with targetOrigin '*' because it cannot know its parent's origin (no referrer) and frame-ancestors already limits who the parent can be (answer.js:27-29); a parent checks event.source against the frame's contentWindow and event.origin against the answer origin, as asks.js does. Every message is a hint with nothing in it a page could use: counts, an ask id, a decision word.

size.description: Document to parent: my content height, on every change (answer.js createMessenger size). The parent sets the iframe's height, clamped to 22..480 (asks.js SIZE_MIN, SIZE_MAX). A frame that posts no size within 3 s never loaded (asks.js LOAD_MS).

done.description: Document to parent: the ask was decided (answer.js createMessenger done). result is counts only: numbers and booleans, at most 2 KB (answer.js cleanResult), never a restore id or a command.

open_chat.description: Document to parent: the user asked to open the chat at this ask (answer.js createMessenger openChat). The chrome opens its awaiting view; the shell activates the chat's tab.

pending.description: Document to parent (08 C-08.8, new): a decision click the document's guard allowed, and the undo window is open; the document sends nothing until undo_ms has passed, then POSTs decide with the version the click saw and posts done. Only sent when the document was opened with ?undo=<ms> greater than 0 (read by answer.js readContext; the shell appends it to frame_url). The parent draws its own pending state from it (the shell's 'Allowing... Undo' line) and never decides from it; Undo is the document's own control.

decision.description: The decision word the document will send (the decide route's `decision`).

undo_ms.description: How long the window is, as the document read it from its URL.

undone.description: Document to parent (08 C-08.8, new): the window ended without sending, on Undo, on a version change of the request or on the ask leaving pending (unload apart); nothing was sent, and the document shows what the ask is now. The parent drops its pending line.

mode.description: Parent to document: light or dark (answer.js onMessage). The document accepts it from window.parent only.
